panels.title: FlinkDeployment / FlinkSessionJob status (current)
panels.description: Current reconciled state of every FlinkDeployment/FlinkSessionJob known to the Flink Kubernetes Operator (flink_kubernetes_operator_flinkdeployment_status) - the operator's own view of RUNNING/SUSPENDED/ERROR, independent of the Control Tower's pipeline_run status.

panels.title: Checkpoint duration
panels.description: Time taken for each Flink job's most recent checkpoint to complete - a sustained upward trend often precedes checkpoint timeouts/failures.

panels.title: Checkpoint failures / restart count
panels.description: Cumulative failed-checkpoint count and restarts in the last 15m per job - either climbing indicates the job is unhealthy even if its overall status still reads RUNNING.

panels.title: TaskManager CPU / memory
panels.description: Per-TaskManager JVM CPU load and heap usage - watch for heap climbing toward max, a leading indicator of an OOM-triggered restart.

panels.title: Backpressure / watermark lag
panels.description: Per-task backpressure flag and current output watermark - sustained backpressure means the job can't keep up with its input rate; a stalled watermark means event-time processing has stopped advancing.

panels.title: JM/TM logs (ERROR/WARN)
panels.description: Log message text (extracted from fluentbit's JSON envelope, not the raw JSON line) containing 'error' or 'warn', from any pod labeled kubernetes.io component=jobmanager or taskmanager, across all Flink jobs in this environment.
